correctness.rationale: Take a flex as elliptic-curve origin. The flexes are E[3], and distinct triples are collinear exactly when their sum is zero; in (Z/3)^2 this is affine collinearity. There are 9 points, 12 lines and 36 incidences. BB^t=3I+J gives Laplacian factors t(t−7), (t−3)^3 and (t²−7t+9)^8, giving matrix-tree count 3^18. Independent exact replay: enumerate distinct triples of F₃² summing to zero, and add the outer product (e_p−e_l)(e_p−e_l)^t for each point–line incidence. Delete row and column 20 in lexicographic point/triple order; SymPy 1.14 smith_normal_form over ZZ gives 1^12,3,9^4,27^3, and exact determinant 387420489. The rectangular incidence matrix instead gives 1^6,3^3. Gluing rational components at distinct marks gives stability by minimum valency 3 and genus 36−21+1=16. For nodal curves the first-order map to local smoothing parameters is surjective and deformations are unobstructed; choose all node parameters nonzero to first order and algebraize the resulting polarized formal family over k[[t]]. This gives split uv=t local equations up to units and regular total space. The component group is the degree-zero multidegree lattice modulo the intersection lattice (matrix −L). The argument does not imply a degeneration of the initial smooth cubic.
